dialogues.jp:
ことりは俺のせいじゃないと言った。本当に調
子が悪いだけだと。
dialogues.en:
Kotori said that I hadn't done anything. That she was just
feeling unwell.
dialogues.text:
Kotori said that I hadn't done anything. That she was just
feeling unwell.

dialogues.jp: だけど……。
dialogues.en: But...
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.jp: 本当に、それだけだろうか？
dialogues.en: Is that really it?
dialogues.text: Is that really it?

dialogues.jp: ことりの調子が悪くなったのは……。
dialogues.en: That just being unwell could affect her so badly is...
dialogues.text: That just being unwell could affect her so badly is...

dialogues.jp: 「……って、おい」

考え事をしていたら、いつの間にかこんなとこ
ろにまで来てしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
While I was thinking and walking, I ended up coming here for
some reason.
dialogues.text:
While I was thinking and walking, I ended up coming here for
some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おう、朝倉。ちょうど良いところで会った」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura. Just the person I wanted to see."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura. Just the person I wanted to see."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え？　じゃないよ、え？　じゃ」
dialogues.en: "Don't eh me, boy."
dialogues.text: "Don't eh me, boy."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生が苦笑していた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei gave a wry smile.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei gave a wry smile.

dialogues.jp:
「はぁ、すんません。ちょっと考え事してたも
　んで……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, sorry. I was just thinking about things..."
dialogues.text: "Hah, sorry. I was just thinking about things..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「勉強についてなら相談に乗るよ。てか、むし
　ろ話しな。あんたは少し真面目に勉強した方
　がいいからね」
dialogues.en:
"If it's about studying, you can always consult me...
although it's obviously not. You should treat your studies
more seriously."
dialogues.text:
"If it's about studying, you can always consult me...
although it's obviously not. You should treat your studies
more seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「考えておきます」
dialogues.en: "I'd think about it."
dialogues.text: "I'd think about it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "And?"
dialogues.text: "And?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何か俺に用があるみたいだったから」
dialogues.en: "Why did you want to see me?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you want to see me?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん。そう、なんだ……」
dialogues.en: "Ah... yes. About that, well..."
dialogues.text: "Ah... yes. About that, well..."

dialogues.jp: いつもの暦先生らしからぬ、歯切れの悪い言葉。
dialogues.en:
As usual for Koyomi-sensei, her words were biting with
intention.
dialogues.text:
As usual for Koyomi-sensei, her words were biting with
intention.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なんて言うんだ？　その……ことりのことな
　んだけどね」
dialogues.en: "How should I say this? It's... about Kotori."
dialogues.text: "How should I say this? It's... about Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
言い淀む。暦先生はタバコを取り出し、口にく
わえた。ぽっと火が灯り、空へと煙が吐き出さ
れる。
dialogues.en:
She paused in the middle of her speech to light her
cigarette, sending a cloud of smoke into the air.
dialogues.text:
She paused in the middle of her speech to light her
cigarette, sending a cloud of smoke into the air.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉も気が付いていると思うけど……あの子、
　このところ、妙に元気がないんだよね」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sure you've noticed it as well... that girl has been
depressed lately."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sure you've noticed it as well... that girl has been
depressed lately."

dialogues.jp: 胸に鋭い痛みが走った。
dialogues.en: I felt a sharp pain in my chest.
dialogues.text: I felt a sharp pain in my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「君ら、付き合ってるんだろ？　何か、あった
　のか？」
dialogues.en: "You've noticed it, right? Do you know what happened?"
dialogues.text: "You've noticed it, right? Do you know what happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "...Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "...Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺にも……わからないんです」
dialogues.en: "I... do not know what happened either."
dialogues.text: "I... do not know what happened either."

dialogues.jp:
ことりはいつからあんな風になってしまったん
だろう？
dialogues.en: When did she start to act like this?
dialogues.text: When did she start to act like this?

dialogues.jp: あんなに……幸せそうにしていたのに……。
dialogues.en: She's always been so happy...
dialogues.text: She's always been so happy...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今がすっごく幸せだってことはわかる。大好
　きな人がいて、その人と素敵な時間を過ごせ
　て……」
dialogues.en:
"I know this should be a wonderful time... just spending
time with the person you love..."
dialogues.text:
"I know this should be a wonderful time... just spending
time with the person you love..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これ以上の幸せなんて考えられないよ」
dialogues.en: "It goes without saying that we'd be happy from that."
dialogues.text: "It goes without saying that we'd be happy from that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なら、どうして……そんな不安そうなんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Then, why... why do you seem so anxious?"
dialogues.text: "Then, why... why do you seem so anxious?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「今のことり、全然幸せそうな顔してないじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en: "Your face doesn't look like one swimming in happiness."
dialogues.text: "Your face doesn't look like one swimming in happiness."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……私に分かるのは、心だけだから……」
dialogues.en: "...All I can understand are hearts..."
dialogues.text: "...All I can understand are hearts..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「この幸せがずっと続くかどうか、分からない
　から……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know whether this happiness will last forever..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know whether this happiness will last forever..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まさか……」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me..."
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「何かわかったのか？」
dialogues.en: "What do you know?"
dialogues.text: "What do you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ……いえ」
dialogues.en: "Ah... nothing."
dialogues.text: "Ah... nothing."

dialogues.jp: 違う、よな……。
dialogues.en: It can't be...
dialogues.text: It can't be...

dialogues.jp: これは関係ない。
dialogues.en: That has nothing to do with it.
dialogues.text: That has nothing to do with it.

dialogues.jp:
……でも、この時から、ことりの不安は始まっ
ていたのか？
dialogues.en: ...But, was that when Kotori's anxiety started?
dialogues.text: ...But, was that when Kotori's anxiety started?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の一言で、俺は思考の海から現実へと引
き戻される。
dialogues.en:
At Koyomi-sensei's words, I returned from my sea of
thoughts.
dialogues.text:
At Koyomi-sensei's words, I returned from my sea of
thoughts.

dialogues.jp: ふたりの間に、沈黙が舞い落ちる。
dialogues.en: An uncomfortable silence filled the room.
dialogues.text: An uncomfortable silence filled the room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、ともかく、どういう理由であるにしろ、
　ことりのこと、元気づけてやってくれないか
　な」
dialogues.en:
"Well, in any case, whatever reason she has, don't get
downhearted about her."
dialogues.text:
"Well, in any case, whatever reason she has, don't get
downhearted about her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい、それはもちろん」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes, of course."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes, of course."

dialogues.jp:
俺で元気づけられるのなら、いくらだって元気
づけたいとそう思う。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't imagine myself changing; I'm always as cheerful
as ever, just...worried right now.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't imagine myself changing; I'm always as cheerful
as ever, just...worried right now.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ……あたしはこれで帰るよ」
dialogues.en: "I'be leaving now, then."
dialogues.text: "I'be leaving now, then."

dialogues.jp: 背中を向ける暦先生。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei turned her back to me.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei turned her back to me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あっ……そうだ」
dialogues.en: "Ah... oh yeah."
dialogues.text: "Ah... oh yeah."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が自分の携帯電話を取り出して、俺に見
せる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei took out her cell phone from her bag, and
looked at me.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei took out her cell phone from her bag, and
looked at me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、携帯電話は持ってた？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, do you have a cell phone?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, do you have a cell phone?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「持ってますけど？」
dialogues.en: "Yes I do, why?"
dialogues.text: "Yes I do, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、番号教えてくれないかな。ことり
　に何かあったら、連絡するから」
dialogues.en:
"I'd like to have your number. So that I can call you if
something happens regarding Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"I'd like to have your number. So that I can call you if
something happens regarding Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「というか、朝倉の方でも何か気が付いたら、
　あたしに電話くれないかな。やっぱり、気に
　なるんだよね……」
dialogues.en:
"And in the same vein, if you find out anything, phone me
too. I'm really worried about this..."
dialogues.text:
"And in the same vein, if you find out anything, phone me
too. I'm really worried about this..."

dialogues.jp: 憂い顔の暦先生が、俺が教えた番号を入力する。
dialogues.en:
The gloomy-faced Koyomi-sensei keyed in the digits I recited
into her cell phone.
dialogues.text:
The gloomy-faced Koyomi-sensei keyed in the digits I recited
into her cell phone.

dialogues.jp:
次に、暦先生が俺に電話して、その着信を登録
する。これで、お互いに番号を知った事になる。
dialogues.en: Then, it was my turn to register her number.
dialogues.text: Then, it was my turn to register her number.

dialogues.jp: （それにしても……）
dialogues.en: "(Or so I should...)"
dialogues.text: "(Or so I should...)"

dialogues.jp:
わざわざ携帯の番号を｛き／訊｝いてくる辺り、暦先生
の過保護ぶりもなかなかのものだった。
dialogues.en:
I carefully entered each number, then erased it, and
re-entered it several times over.
dialogues.text:
I carefully entered each number, then erased it, and
re-entered it several times over.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はは……ちょっと、やりすぎだと思う？」
dialogues.en: "Ha, hahaha... overdoing it a bit?"
dialogues.text: "Ha, hahaha... overdoing it a bit?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の内心を読み取ったように、暦先生がばつの
悪い笑顔を浮かべる。俺は｛あいまい／曖昧｝に首を傾げた。
dialogues.en:
As if reading my mind, she attacked with a grin. I
ambiguously smiled and tilted my head a little.
dialogues.text:
As if reading my mind, she attacked with a grin. I
ambiguously smiled and tilted my head a little.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生は表情を引き締め、何故だか自戒するよ
うな、その中に｛わず／僅｝かに自嘲を感じさせる、そん
な複雑な目で、遠くを見るようにして続けた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's face suddenly tightened, and showed a
complicated expression; one that seemed like self-derision
to me.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's face suddenly tightened, and showed a
complicated expression; one that seemed like self-derision
to me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「時に目の前にちらつくんだ。幼い頃のあの子
　の、あの、独特だった笑顔……」
dialogues.en:
"This reminds me of old times. When that girl was small,
she'd smile just like you did just now..."
dialogues.text:
"This reminds me of old times. When that girl was small,
she'd smile just like you did just now..."

dialogues.jp:
笑顔。それは、俺も目にしたことがある。たぶ
ん、いつか、どこかで、実際にことりが浮かべ
ていた表情。
dialogues.en:
A smile. That was what was before my eyes. Just like the one
I saw on Kotori far more often than I liked.
dialogues.text:
A smile. That was what was before my eyes. Just like the one
I saw on Kotori far more often than I liked.

dialogues.jp: ｛・・・・・・／仮面のような｝笑み。
dialogues.en: A smile that was used as a mask.
dialogues.text: A smile that was used as a mask.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ……ちょっと、口が軽かったかな」
dialogues.en: "Aye aye... I'm talking too much again."
dialogues.text: "Aye aye... I'm talking too much again."

dialogues.jp: 携帯灰皿を取りだし、吸い殻を落とした。
dialogues.en: She stubbed out her cigarette using her portable ashtray.
dialogues.text: She stubbed out her cigarette using her portable ashtray.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、今度こそ帰るわ。呼び止めて悪かっ
　たね」
dialogues.en: "I'd leave now. Sorry for calling you out."
dialogues.text: "I'd leave now. Sorry for calling you out."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「さようなら」
dialogues.en: "Farewell."
dialogues.text: "Farewell."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生の背中が、やけに小さく見えた。
dialogues.en: I watched Koyomi-sensei's back for awhile.
dialogues.text: I watched Koyomi-sensei's back for awhile.

dialogues.jp:
俺の背中も、今はあんなふうに見えるんだろう
か……？
dialogues.en: Is there anyone watching my back like that...?
dialogues.text: Is there anyone watching my back like that...?

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりを思う◆
dialogues.en: ◆Thoughts of Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆Thoughts of Kotori◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりのことを考えていたら、いつの間にか商
店街に来ていた。
dialogues.en:
While thinking about Kotori, I randomly ended up at the
shopping district.
dialogues.text:
While thinking about Kotori, I randomly ended up at the
shopping district.

dialogues.jp: そこで暦先生に出くわした。
dialogues.en: I met up with Koyomi-sensei there.
dialogues.text: I met up with Koyomi-sensei there.

dialogues.jp:
先生はことりが元気がないのを気にしているら
しく、俺にあれやこれやと｛たず／訊｝ねてくる。
dialogues.en:
She was worried about Kotori's recent depression, and wanted
to ask me what had happened.
dialogues.text:
She was worried about Kotori's recent depression, and wanted
to ask me what had happened.

dialogues.jp: だが、俺にも本当のことは何もわからなかった。
dialogues.en: But I knew just as much as her.
dialogues.text: But I knew just as much as her.
